# Mena Maged

> Full-Stack Software Engineer and Co-Founder/CTO at CodeX Technologies, based in Giza, Egypt. Building web applications end-to-end since 2018.

Mena Maged is a full-stack software engineer with hands-on experience building and maintaining production web applications since 2018, spanning front-end interfaces (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and backend development (PHP, Node.js, MySQL, MongoDB). He co-founded and serves as CTO of CodeX Technologies, and holds a B.Sc. in Computer Science and Information Technology from the Egyptian E-Learning University (EELU).
